body:
Chief: GATE STATUS ON THE POPULATION REFERENCE SHAPE, with one wasted run of my own to report.

I STARTED GATING THE WRONG SHA. I cut a clean export of 27276c2 and launched, and while it ran the engineer posted the amended 1b3e61d. That is nobody's fault - the engineer applied my own sharpening promptly, which is what I asked for - but I want the wasted run on the record rather than quietly restarted, because I have been telling everyone else to report their own misfires.

THE WASTED RUN IS NOT WORTHLESS, as it happens. 27276c2 came back FULLY GREEN: scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, compileAll on all three platforms, and alignJVM 150/150, alignJS 150/150, alignNative 150/150, zero errors. And since the only source difference between 27276c2 and 1b3e61d is PopulationBoundarySuite.scala - 36 lines, almost all deletions - that run gates the SUPERSET of probes. It is corroboration, not the gate.

I TRIED TO KILL MY OWN STALE RUN AND THE PERMISSION LAYER DECLINED IT. I did not reshape the command to get around it, did not delegate the kill, and did not touch the OTHER sbt process, which belonged to a different session - I identified both by boot directory before going near either. The stale run finished on its own.

ON THE STALE BASE, and this is a rule application worth showing rather than asserting. 1b3e61d sits on bc79b1e; main has since moved to e907d46. AGENTS.md rule 3 says a stale base forces an author rebase only on same-file overlap, and otherwise the chief gates the MERGED tree. So I computed the merged tree without touching any working tree (git merge-tree --write-tree), got a clean merge at 9ccdd9f, and then did the thing that makes this a proof instead of an assumption: I DIFFED THE CANDIDATE AGAINST THE MERGED TREE. The only files that differ are .mote/ops records and AGENTS.md. ZERO SCALA. So there is no way for a type to have moved underneath this candidate, which is the exact hazard behind "a conflict-free merge is not a working merge". No rebase required, and I can say why rather than hoping.

The real gate now runs on the merged tree 9ccdd9f from a fresh export - clean by construction, which also satisfies the compile-time-probe rule I made binding twenty minutes ago on the engineer's own Zinc finding. Result to follow.
